checks: Explicit Save is available before manual verification; cancel never writes or clears the draft
Source Save automatically verifies its immutable snapshot and rereads the saved document
A stale preview cannot be reused; direct Save validates the newer draft instead
Reload requires a deliberate discard; cancellation and read failure retain the draft, successful reload clears it
During native writing, target selection, edit, undo, reload and navigation cannot alter the saving document; editing resumes after completion
Validation and write failures preserve the exact draft; explicit retry succeeds without weakening native gates
A successful write followed by a read failure is reported honestly and retains the draft
Body/list/table multi-target copy saves automatically, collision retains all edits, source remains unchanged, complex content is preserved
Ctrl+S uses the same explicit confirmation and safe save workflow
Save-and-leave checks and saves before navigation without requiring a separate verification step
A confirmation from another library cannot authorize a stale save
All six visual styles, light/dark, normal motion and 760/480/360px preserve readable controls and drafts without page overflow
External documents remain read-only with no write entry point
